# utils/ledgers/quarantine.txt — the findings of the quarantine plugin and the opt-out regions in each
# directory and kind.
#
# The rule quarantine reads this ledger (`python3 utils/bin/guard explain quarantine`).  Its module
# utils/assay/guard/engines/plugin/quarantine.py writes each count row and this head through
# utils/assay/core/ledger.py.  Do not edit a count row by hand.  The rule reads the section
# .crucible.quarantine of each object of the target all, and the census in the record of the run
# of each negative fixture.  It counts each finding line one time.  The directory of the source of a
# fixture, such as test/foundation/neg/, is a directory of this ledger too.
#
# A count above its row fails the rule, because a change can only lower a count (rule R11 of
# misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md).  A directory that the ledger does not hold and that has a finding
# fails too: a new directory has no finding.  A count below its row passes.  A row holds no entity,
# so a change that replaces a finding with a different finding of the same kind in one directory
# passes.  A move of code to a different directory needs `guard write --raise` with the reason in
# the commit.
#     python3 utils/bin/guard list --build-dir build --path DIRECTORY/
# prints each finding of a directory with its file, its line and its entity.
# On a merge conflict in this file, take the version of main, and write each raise of the change again.
#
# THE ROWS (the rows grammar of utils/assay/core/rows.py)
#   reason PREFIX | REASON         The reason of each count row of a directory under PREFIX: the
#                                  step of the plan that removes its findings.  A person writes these
#                                  rows, and a write removes a row that holds no count row (THE
#                                  REASON OF A PREFIX of utils/assay/core/ledger.py).
#   DIRECTORY | KIND | COUNT | - | -
#                                  The number of findings of the kind KIND in the files of the
#                                  directory, with no file of a directory under it.  A directory has
#                                  '/' at its end, and the build directory has the prefix @build/.
#                                  The head comment of utils/tools/quarantine/plugin.h gives the
#                                  kinds.
#
# THE OPT-OUT REGIONS
#   DIRECTORY | region | COUNT | REASON | -
#   DIRECTORY | opted-out | COUNT | REASON | -
#   Each region is a reviewed exception, so its rows keep its reason.  A row of the kind region
#   counts the regions of the directory with the reason REASON.  A row of the kind opted-out counts
#   the findings that those regions cover.  A region that covers more, and a new region, fail the
#   rule until
#       python3 utils/bin/guard write --rule quarantine --build-dir build --admit
#   writes the new count.  Use --admit only for a region of a reason class of CLAUDE.md section
#   XXII, and give the reason in the commit.  Only a region that a build compiles, or that the
#   census of a fixture holds, has a row.
#
# THE KINDS OF A PROBE
#   DIRECTORY | KIND | COUNT | - | REASON
#   In the census of a fixture, the rule also counts the kinds detail-use, lifetime-start,
#   unchecked-use and door-use.  Each such row is a reviewed exception, and REASON tells what the
#   fixtures of the directory probe.  A row of such a kind with no reason fails the rule.  A new
#   count of such a kind needs `guard write --rule quarantine --build-dir build --admit --reason TEXT`.
#
# ONE SET OF ROWS
#   One set of rows judges each build.  The count of a key is its largest count over the
#   configurations of the landing gate: each configure preset with the tier gate, the builds of
#   objects and the two parse builds (utils/assay/loop/gate.py).  A build of a different
#   configuration gets the same verdict, for example an aarch64 build of objects in CI.  A count
#   above its row fails it.  A build with no fixture run, such as a parse build, gives the counts
#   of its objects only, and the rows of the fixtures come from the builds of objects.
#   python3 utils/bin/guard write --rule quarantine --build-dir build
#   writes the counts of one build.  It lowers no row, because one build cannot see the findings of
#   a different build.  A landing of `python3 utils/bin/loop land` that builds each configuration of
#   the gate lowers each row to that largest count, and it folds the ledger into the commit (THE
#   REDUCE of utils/assay/loop/gate.py).
#   The vessel units that need PyTorch compile only when TORCH_DIR is set.  No configuration of the
#   gate sets TORCH_DIR, so the ledger does not count those units, and their findings fail a build
#   with TORCH_DIR.
#   No configuration turns on CRUCIBLE_SENSE_HUB_V2.  Each build compiles the SenseHub v2 sources
#   in two object libraries that no target links, with and without CRUCIBLE_SENSE_HUB_EXTENDED
#   (CMakeLists.txt), so these rows count each arm of those sources.  A finding of an arm that only
#   a preset outside the gate compiles, such as the verify preset or a PGO preset, fails its build.
format 1
rule quarantine
reason @build/ | The unit perf of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md moves the embed of each BPF object onto the types of the base
reason @build/test/ | The unit tests of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md moves each generated test header onto the types of the base
reason bench/ | The unit bench of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md moves bench/ onto the types of the base, and bench/bench_harness.h goes first
reason examples/ | The unit small of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md moves examples/ onto the types of the base
reason include/crucible/ | The units core-ir, vigil, cipher, cntp, observe, cog-mimic, perf and rest of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md move include/crucible/ onto the types of the base
reason include/fixy/ | The slices of section 13.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md move fixy onto the families of the base, and the slice 4.9 removes each other std use, one unit for each directory
reason include/fixy/os/ | The slices 4.1 and 4.6 of section 13.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md move the doors of fixy onto the Os family, with no system type in a signature
reason include/foundation/ | The slices of section 13.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md move foundation onto the families of the base, and the slice 4.8 removes each other std use
reason src/ | The unit small of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md moves src/ onto the types of the base
reason src/fixy/ | The slices 4.1, 4.6 and 4.9 of section 13.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md move the source files of fixy onto the families of the base
reason src/foundation/ | The slices 4.5 and 4.8 of section 13.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md move the source files of foundation onto the families of the base
reason test/ | The units harness, tests and fixtures of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md move test/ onto the types of the base
reason test/fuzz/ | The unit fuzz of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md moves test/fuzz/ onto the types of the base, and the entry of libFuzzer keeps a region
reason utils/tools/ | The unit tools of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md moves utils/tools/ onto the types of the base
reason vessel/ | The unit vessel of section 14.1 of the plan misc/01_10_2026_quarantine.md moves vessel/ onto the types of the base, and the ABI of PyTorch stays behind regions
